dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Consistent, symmetrical narrowing from the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Smooth lateral margins with no visible asymmetrical bulges or indentations at the water-skin interface.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Medium slate-grey baseline across the visible dorsal area, indicating a sub-adult or non-mature skin tone.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Faint, light-colored linear parallel marks (rake marks) on the posterior right dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of multiple faint, linear white scars (healed rake marks) on the lower right posterior flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct, dark elliptical blowhole on the anterior midline of the dorsal surface.
